mentions.name: AI-designed 3D-printed toys
mentions.description: This project uses basic AI tools to design toys that can then be 3D printed, made for the builder's 4-year-old kid.
mentions.source_excerpt: Using basic AI tools to design and create toys that we can 3D print, for my 4yo kid.  This has been a big hit with her.
mentions.author: binarysolo
